en: A black‑and‑white postcard photograph showing a richly decorated Baroque-style church altar. The altar features sculpted columns, angels, relief scenes including the Crucifixion and the Resurrection, ornamental scrollwork, and a statue of Christ with a banner on the top. The image is vertically oriented, and along the right edge there is printed white text indicating the subject of the photograph.
